# GatherGate

> Self-hosted, MIT-licenced magic-link client document intake portal, deterministic validator engine, and operator review console. Built on Node.js >= 22.13 (Node 24+ recommended), Hono (5 backend production dependencies), SQLite WAL (`node:sqlite`), AES-256-GCM per-record encryption, React 19, and Tailwind CSS v4 with zero telemetry.

- Website: https://gathergate.tensorforge.dev/
- Documentation: https://gathergate.tensorforge.dev/docs/
- Full compiled docs (agent reference): https://gathergate.tensorforge.dev/docs/llms-full.txt
- Per-page raw Markdown: append `.md` to any docs slug (e.g. `https://gathergate.tensorforge.dev/docs/guides/ai-agents.md`, `https://gathergate.tensorforge.dev/docs/deployment/one-click-templates.md`)
- Interactive browser demo (no server): https://gathergate.tensorforge.dev/demo/#/
- Source repository: https://github.com/FAAS19/gathergate
- MCP Registry manifest: https://github.com/FAAS19/gathergate/blob/main/server.json
- Bundled Agent Skill (`SKILL.md`, `SEP-2640`): https://github.com/FAAS19/gathergate/blob/main/skills/gathergate/SKILL.md
- Security policy: https://github.com/FAAS19/gathergate/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Contact: contact@tensorforge.dev

## Agent Installation Protocol

Follow these steps in order when helping a user install GatherGate:

1. **Check prerequisites first**:
   - Run `docker --version` (and `docker compose version`) and/or `node -v` (requires `>= 22.13.0`, Node 24+ recommended).
2. **Ask before writing files or starting services**:
   - Confirm preferred runtime: Docker container (`ghcr.io/faas19/gathergate:latest`), Docker Compose from source, or native Node.js.
   - Confirm host bind address and port (default `127.0.0.1:3080`).
   - Confirm persistent storage path or Docker volume (default `DATA_DIR=./data` or volume `gathergate_data`).
3. **Install and start using the user's chosen method**:
   - **Option A: Docker image (`linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`)**
     ```bash
     docker run -d \
       --name gathergate \
       -p 127.0.0.1:3080:3080 \
       -v gathergate_data:/data \
       ghcr.io/faas19/gathergate:latest
     ```
   - **Option B: Docker Compose from source**
     ```bash
     git clone https://github.com/FAAS19/gathergate.git \
       && cd gathergate \
       && docker compose up -d --build
     ```
   - **Option C: Native Node.js (`npx`)**
     ```bash
     npx gathergate
     ```
   - **Option D: Native Node.js from source**
     ```bash
     git clone https://github.com/FAAS19/gathergate.git \
       && cd gathergate \
       && npm ci \
       && npm --prefix client ci \
       && npm run build \
       && NODE_ENV=production HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=3080 DATA_DIR=./data npm start
     ```
4. **Verify health before finishing**:
   - Check `GET http://127.0.0.1:3080/healthz` returns HTTP `200`.
   - Tell the user to open `http://127.0.0.1:3080` in their browser to complete initial workspace setup.

## Key Configuration (`.env.example`)

- `MASTER_KEY`: 64-char hex key (32 bytes) for HKDF + AES-256-GCM encryption. If unset on first boot, GatherGate generates one at `DATA_DIR/.master.key` and reminds operators to move it into environment variables for production.
- `HOST` / `PORT` / `BASE_URL`: Bind `127.0.0.1:3080` locally; set `TRUST_PROXY=true` and `BASE_URL=https://your-domain` only behind a trusted TLS reverse proxy (Caddy, Nginx, or Cloudflare Tunnel).
- `STORAGE_BACKEND`: `local` (`DATA_DIR/blobs`) or `s3` (S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Backblaze B2 via SigV4).
- `EMAIL_BACKEND`: `console` (built-in Local Email Outbox), `smtp`, or `resend`.
- `DEFAULT_PURGE_DAYS`: Default `30` (`14` auto-default for sensitive national ID packs).

## Built-In Stateless MCP 2.0 Endpoint (`POST /mcp`)

Every self-hosted GatherGate server exposes a stateless Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint at `POST /mcp` (protocol `2026-07-28` + legacy `2025-11-25`..`2024-11-05`) authenticated via scoped workspace API keys (`Authorization: Bearer gg_live_...`).

- **Metadata-only invariant**: MCP tools (`list_templates`, `list_requests`, `get_request_status`, `list_overdue_requests`, `create_request`, `send_reminder`, `update_due_date`) return pack metadata (including `client_name` for non-purged requests and masked emails) and never expose decrypted TFNs/Medicare/NINO/SSN values, submitted item values, client notes, uploaded file names, file bytes, workspace secrets, or raw magic-link tokens.
- **Bundled Skill (`SEP-2640`)**: Discoverable via `skills/list` / `skills/get` and readable at `skill://gathergate/SKILL.md`.
- **Agent setup guides**: https://gathergate.tensorforge.dev/docs/guides/ai-agents.md
- **1-Click deploy manifests** (Render `render.yaml`, Coolify, Dokploy, Railway, Umbrel, CasaOS, Fly.io): https://gathergate.tensorforge.dev/docs/deployment/one-click-templates.md

## Agent Safety Rules

- Never print, echo, or commit `.env`, `.master.key`, `MASTER_KEY`, or `gg_live_...` API key values.
- Never bind GatherGate to `0.0.0.0` or expose port `3080` publicly without a TLS reverse proxy and `BASE_URL=https://...`.
